title: How many tenths long is a pencil of three and four tenths?
description: A pencil is three and four tenths units long. The three units are changed to tenths because ten tenths make one unit, the four tenths are added, and the result is checked by breaking it back into units. Keeko doubts the count and adds the three and the four.
teaching_notes: One idea: ten tenths make one unit, so the units are multiplied by ten and the tenths are added. Watch for students who add the whole units to the tenths as if both were tenths.

source: A pencil is 3 4/10 units long. Write its length as a count of tenths and show why it is the same length.
video_script.why: The child has written a length as units and tenths but not yet as a single count of tenths.
video_script.substitution: Ten tenths make one unit, so three units are thirty tenths, and four more tenths make thirty four tenths.
video_script.anchor: A pencil that is three units and four tenths long, drawn on a bar cut into tenths
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko adds the 3 units to the 4 tenths to get 3 + 4 = 7 tenths, but 3 units are 30 tenths, so the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: The pencil is thirty four tenths of a unit long

final_answer.spoken: thirty four tenths of a unit

maths_rules: 10 one-tenths make 1 unit, so 3 units = 3 × 10 = 30 tenths.
30 tenths + 4 tenths = 34 tenths, so the length is 34/10 units.
Check: 34 tenths = 10 tenths + 10 tenths + 10 tenths + 4 tenths = 1 + 1 + 1 + 4/10 = 3 4/10.
Slip: 3 + 4 = 7 tenths, but 3 units are 30 tenths.
video_script.design: One idea: ten tenths make one unit, so units become tenths by multiplying by ten. Assumes one tenth of a unit is known. Wrong idea: add the units to the tenths. The pencil bar stays all video.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, change the three units to tenths. Ten tenths make one unit, so three units are three times ten, which is thirty tenths.

marks.two: the 4 tenths join the 30 tenths and 34 tenths is written

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, add the four tenths. Thirty tenths and four tenths make thirty four tenths.

beats.on_screen: check: 34 tenths = 10 tenths + 10 tenths + 10 tenths + 4 tenths = 1 + 1 + 1 + 4/10 = 3 4/10

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, check that it is the same length. Thirty four tenths is ten tenths three times, and four tenths more.
<bookmark mark='units'/>Each ten tenths is one unit, so that is one, one, one and four tenths.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The pencil is thirty four tenths of a unit long.
It is the same length as three units and four tenths.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 3 + 4 = 7 tenths; the pencil bar shows 3 full units beside it; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.fix: the bubble is struck through and the 3 full unit bars glow, each cut into 10 tenths

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the pencil is seven tenths, because three and four make seven.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But the pencil is longer than three whole units, and seven tenths is shorter than one unit. Three units are not three tenths. They are thirty tenths.
